Algebra 1 · Unit 2: Solving Equations and Inequalities

Variables on Both Sides

Collect variable terms on one side to solve equations where the variable appears twice, including ones with no solution or infinitely many.

What you’ll learn

  • Solve equations with variables on both sides
  • Recognize equations with no solution or infinitely many solutions
  • Solve “when are they equal” problems

The mountain biking connection

When will a rider starting 2 km behind but riding faster catch up? Set both positions equal and solve.

Learning activities

Interactive lab · from Algebra 1: One-Step Equations

The Dream Line Goes Pro

The Dream Line Project, engineered: solve for missing setup measurements on an equation balance, plan construction with multi-step equations, compare park designs with variables on both sides, rearrange speed, trail-grade and suspension-sag formulas, and keep the park within its budget and design limits with inequalities.

Level
Beginner to Advanced
Time
40-55 min
  • 5 stages
  • Equation balance and multi-step solver
  • Design Showdown graph
  • Formula Garage
  • Number Line Studio
  • Final Park Engineer Certification (10)
  • Continues your Unit 1 park

Practises here: Solve equations with variables on both sides; Solve “when are they equal” problems; Recognize equations with no solution or infinitely many solutions

Opens at: Stage 3: The Design Showdown · or start from the beginning
